_comment: Figures read off each site by eye, with the date they were read. Neither of these accounts can
be scraped: DigitalCore's API key returns 403 on every user endpoint, and C411's Prowlarr entry
is API-key only, so it holds no login to reuse. Without this file their rows on the dashboard are
empty, which is how a thin ratio goes unnoticed. Every panel shows the age of the reading next to
the number, because a figure with no date is worse than no figure.
Sizes are GiB, matching what the sites display. Update whenever a profile page is in front of you.

digitalcore.note: buffer 67.15 GiB, leech bonus 19%, class Sentinel, 11 torrents seeding, no hit and run. Counted 78.83 GiB up against 53.83 GiB really uploaded (their upload multipliers) and 11.68 GiB counted down against 351.97 GiB really downloaded. The signup freeleech expired on 2026-08-14 and the counted figure has not moved since, because everything grabbed after it was 15 GiB or larger, which their rules make free anyway.

c411.note: 50 of those 52.8 GB are the signup credit, so 2.8 GB is what this account has really uploaded, up from 2.2 GB on 2026-08-21. The credit does not grow back. Downloaded has not moved since the first reading and the site shows no hit and run system, so time is the only thing owed here.

retrotoon.note: site-wide freeleech until about 2026-09-30, so downloads cost nothing against ratio
